body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q2FY25 call (2024-11-08), prompted: "my goal is to have this platform actually come to us within the next year or so" Metric: Acquisition / third product platform. Target: Platform added. Deadline: 2025-12-31 (half-year). Specificity: vague. Status as of 2026-11-19: MISSED. Evidence: Deadline (~end-2025) passed with no deal. Admitted only in answer to an analyst on 2026-05-26 (two near-misses, about a dozen targets screened). Small/mid fabrication is being built organically but is not yet a platform. Management explanation: Deals fell apart; would not overpay or buy a turnaround.
